check.name: research cites + digest
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('{result}').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if ('http' in t and 'Digest' in t) else 1)

check.name: spec has the four parts
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('{result}').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if all(k in t for k in ('Nodes','Edges','Output','Coverage')) else 1)

check.name: tool exists and parses
cmd: import ast,pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('.claude/skills/workflow-design/scripts/code_graph.py'); sys.exit(0 if (p.exists() and ast.parse(p.read_text()) is not None) else 1)

nodes.sabotage: remove a call from the fixture -> an edge disappears -> the check goes red

check.name: cases have negative + %
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('{result}').read_text().lower(); sys.exit(0 if ('negative' in t and '%' in t) else 1)

nodes.sabotage: a seeded mutant in the tool must be caught by the cases -> the check goes red otherwise

check.name: review has checklist + line refs
cmd: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('{result}').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if ('Checklist' in t and ':' in t) else 1)

check.name: tool runs on repo, valid JSON
cmd: import subprocess,json,sys; r=subprocess.run(['python3','.claude/skills/workflow-design/scripts/code_graph.py','.'],capture_output=True,text=True); d=json.loads(r.stdout); sys.exit(0 if ('nodes' in d and 'edges' in d) else 1)

nodes.sabotage: delete a known function -> its node disappears from the graph -> the check goes red
